subject: prd/tech-design-brainstorm
statement: question turns legible in the authority's register — example-anchored comparable options, panel alternatives traced through the same example, no bare anchors (FR-17)
intent: fixture corpus, all interview turns incl. fired-panel and extension fixtures
fit_criterion: 100% of turns carry the FR-17 form; zero unglossed corpus anchors; zero example-bearing turns with two options sharing an outcome; fired panels present each alternative's outcome on the turn's example; typed example-skips only where no illustrative case exists (judged at the report); example fidelity — every example presented as looked-up verifies against its named source at the report, and every invented example is marked hypothetical or illustrative (a fabricated-as-real example is a fail)
